inlines.text: 网络安全初创公司Cathedral利用AI智能体，通过第三方商业软件渗透进Anthropic的内部系统，借助这家AI实验室自己的漏洞赏金计划揭露了重大漏洞。

blocks.text: 据《华盛顿邮报》审阅的一份报告草稿，Cathedral报告称其访问了内部数据和消息系统。这家初创公司由美国政府效率机构DOGE的前员工创立，向政府机构和企业销售AI驱动的安全工具。

inlines.text: AI 智能体正在改变网络安全格局

blocks.text: 在数月来关于 AI 驱动网络攻击的警告以及其自身意外安全事件之后，Anthropic 如今成了被攻击的一方。AI 智能体正在改变网络攻击的运作方式，而这次入侵表明这种转变发生得有多快。这也不只是一次普通的入侵，因为 Anthropic 很可能是最有能力防御 AI 主导攻击的公司。

blocks.text: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to infiltrate Anthropic's internal systems through third-party business software, exploiting the AI lab's own bug bounty program to expose major vulnerabilities.

inlines.text: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to infiltrate Anthropic's internal systems through third-party business software, exploiting the AI lab's own bug bounty program to expose major vulnerabilities.

blocks.text: Cathedral reported its access to internal data and messaging systems in a draft report reviewed by The Washington Post. The startup, founded by former employees of DOGE, the U.S. government efficiency agency, sells AI-powered security tools to government agencies and businesses.

inlines.text: Cathedral reported its access to internal data and messaging systems in a draft report reviewed by The Washington Post. The startup, founded by former employees of DOGE, the U.S. government efficiency agency, sells AI-powered security tools to government agencies and businesses.

blocks.text: Cathedral's researchers got in through external admin and sales programs. According to their report, AI agents running advanced models found paths to meeting transcripts, salary data, job postings, and Slack messages in under twelve hours.

inlines.text: Cathedral's researchers got in through external admin and sales programs. According to their report, AI agents running advanced models found paths to meeting transcripts, salary data, job postings, and Slack messages in under twelve hours.

blocks.text: Anthropic confirmed that the researchers accessed a limited set of sales, human resources, and IT systems, including contact information for some customers and partners along with basic user account data. Chats with Claude, source code, and model weights were never exposed, the company said. Anthropic shut down the affected access points the same day it found the breach, disabled the third-party programs until the issue was resolved, and notified U.S. federal authorities.

inlines.text: Anthropic and Cathedral disagree on how long the breach lasted and how far it reached

blocks.text: Cathedral says the incident took less than twelve hours. Anthropic says the attempted attack stretched over several days. Only after days of probing Anthropic's own systems did the startup pivot to third-party software, according to Anthropic red teamer Logan Graham. There, Cathedral found two vulnerabilities but reported only one. Anthropic says it discovered and patched the second on its own.

blocks.text: AI agents are transforming cybersecurity

inlines.text: AI agents are transforming cybersecurity

blocks.text: After months of warnings about AI-powered cyberattacks and its own accidental security incidents, Anthropic is now on the receiving end. AI agents are changing how cyberattacks work, and this breach shows how fast the shift is happening. It's also not just any breach, since Anthropic is likely the company best equipped to defend itself against AI-led attacks.

Even models half a generation to a full generation behind the current frontier are capable enough for these attacks, he said, and future adversaries will inevitably have more powerful systems at their disposal.
